contract: PowerSI is comparison-only; this runner never fits solver parameters from Touchstone values.
run_schema: runs.candidate is keyed by string modal_max_index; it is empty only when run_execution.candidate records an explicit skipped status

solver_provenance.network_math: independent physical layer/net surface nodes; adjacent exact-artwork Maxwell Y; source-observed vertical links; one global open-port Schur/Kron reduction
solver_provenance.nonuniform_correction: legacy rectangular higher modes on the profile terminal/artwork envelope
solver_provenance.topology_assumption: only exact same-NET Trace/Via graph components that contact retained artwork connect physical surfaces; aggregate padstack spans are not fabricated
solver_provenance.via_rl_scope: branched substrate components contribute exact connectivity but no invented serial R/L; terminal and decap loop R/L remain in their separately owned branches
solver_provenance.spatial_scope: uniform potential per physical layer/net surface; no secondary-layer lateral spreading, via mutual, pad/antipad exact-core, or arbitrary S-matrix multiplication
